name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 35 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-11-20, at wavelengths from 1.02 to 4.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
